production-baseline.note: The production route's request-side values predate the profile table, are pinned byte for byte by the adapter suite, and have never been transmitted live. `authorization: Bearer` is what adapter revision 1 has always sent on this route.

tool-calls-guide.source: DeepSeek official Tool Calls guide, api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/tool_calls
tool-calls-guide.note: Documents function tools with `strict` JSON-schema parameters and states "From DeepSeek-V3.2, the API supports tool use in the thinking mode." The `tool_choice` values and the thinking-mode round-trip rules are not on that page and remain for the first live item (ADR 0080 §2).

no-web-search.source: DeepSeek official — Tool Calls guide, Chat Completions reference, Responses API guide (api-docs.deepseek.com)
no-web-search.note: The Tool Calls guide admits only `"type": "function"`, the Chat Completions reference states "Currently, only functions are supported as a tool", and the Responses API guide marks `web_search` `Ignored` (ADR 0080 §3).

chat-completions-reference.source: DeepSeek official Create Chat Completion reference, api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion
chat-completions-reference.note: Lists `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` as the request's model ids; the non-streaming response carries the answer as the string `choices[0].message.content` and, in thinking mode (the `thinking` parameter defaults to enabled), the reasoning as the string `choices[0].message.reasoning_content`.

models-and-pricing.source: DeepSeek official API documentation, models and pricing pages (api-docs.deepseek.com), as ADR 0080 §3 records them
models-and-pricing.note: Prints `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and `deepseek-v4-pro` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813), each with a 1M context.

routes.note: The production connection's route, unchanged: the one route that sends the DSH attribution headers and reads a 429 as a retryable rate limit. Chat completions names no output cap, so the route sends no such field.

models.note: The production model. Its request side is exactly what adapter revision 1 has always sent; its response side has never been observed, so every other read-side capability is absent. By the vendor's notice, from 12:00 Beijing time on 2026-09-14 requests for this id are routed to V4.1 Flash (ADR 0080 §3); the id is not moved here (ADR 0080 §5.3).

The vendor's current id for V4.1 Flash, named by Provider Processing v13's ordinary-production binding for the DeepSeek 开放平台（官方） route (Issue #811). Answer and reasoning channels are the vendor's documented response contract, which the #811 ordinary-production observation of 2026-10-15 (one baseline Task, recorded on the Issue, no ledger line by design) agreed with; it sends no unverified format, reasoning-control or tool parameters.

openQuestions: Every read-side capability of the production route — answer channel beyond the request baseline, structured output, reasoning channel, usage attribution — must be established by vendor documentation or a named live test item before the first production Run (ADR 0080 §4).
